name: South Nature and Climate Action Fund
summary: Small council grants for local not-for-profit groups and parish councils in South Oxfordshire to take climate action and support nature recovery, including habitat creation and restoration and community access to nature.

pool.quote: South Oxfordshire District Council has a budget of £100,000 to award to projects across South Oxfordshire

applicant_types.quote: Town/parish councils and parish meetings Local 'not for profit' organisations, (this can include a company limited by guarantee which does not distribute any surplus it makes to its members), whose primary purpose is to benefit the residents of South Oxfordshire

geography.quote: Projects must take place within the South Oxfordshire district for the benefit of South Oxfordshire residents

access.quote: Organisations apply using the council's online grants management system

amount.quote: The minimum grant you can apply for is £250 and the maximum is £10,000

window.quote: Usually, the scheme will be open for one round of applications per financial year

co_finance_required.quote: We can fund up to 100 per cent of the total cost of a project (budget permitting)
